calculation.expression: -rolling_sum(residual_log_return,3)/rolling_std(residual_log_return,20), lagged 1 day; active when 20d benchmark return < 0 OR 20d residual dispersion exceeds its 120d median
calculation.description: Ranks assets for reversal of unusually large recent idiosyncratic three-day shocks, volatility normalized and conditioned on weak or high-dispersion benchmark regimes. Residual returns are asset log returns minus the equal-weight mean of the 15 tradable instruments.

validation.regime_notes: No qualifying observations in 2020-2023 due to warmup/conditioning. IC/ICIR: 2024-2026 0.07668/0.25324 (104 dates); 2027-2029 0.00436/0.01622 (643); 2030-2032 0.03856/0.14354 (426). Small 15-asset cross-section implies conservative interpretation.
